prompt: An increasing number of people are changing careers during their working life. What do you think are the reasons of this? Is it a positive or a negative development for society?
essay:
Introduction

In a fast-growing world, it is very important for us to learn more skills and keep developing ourselves, and this will create new opportunities that we have to grab. Sometimes, it is in the forward direction, or sometimes it is different from routine work. I strongly believe that changing career paths after starting to earn is in favour of society. This will be discussed in this essay.

Body Paragraph 1

Firstly, to commence with, in the modern era, anyone can learn at any age, whether it is related to their stream or not, and this will help to increase the literacy rate of the nation. Moreover, it will increase competition in the market and motivate employees to enhance their working capacity. Hard work pays off when they change the field as desired and according to current requirements.

Body Paragraph 2

For instance, sometimes pupils, while choosing a field, might not know very well about the practical implications. Therefore, at the end of completing their studies and doing the job, they face certain types of problems, such as being unable to produce the expected output, or they might lose interest in their work.

Conclusion

As a result, workers start thinking about changing jobs and doing whatever they want to do, according to their interests, because having an interest in work will affect a person’s personal life or work life. In a recent survey of online studies, 70% of people take subscriptions to online courses, and they come online to add more degrees to their curriculum and also learn what they have not yet done and give one more chance to their passion. In recent times, there are many streams which might be highly affected by technology, infrastructure, and the COVID pandemic, which will change the working style compared with before this decade. So, nowadays, people are constantly working on their resumes to make them stronger, improve their knowledge, and change their jobs according to the opportunities.
